messages:
pat (Marketing): Pushed a concise launch post draft to Drive. Angle: 'practical inference playbook' with a short checklist for engineers and a one-paragraph business impact. Link: https://docs.example.com/launch-compact-draft
dee (Growth): Nice. Request: gate a 1-page playbook asset for MQL capture and run a simple A/B on email subject lines.
ishaan (Product): I'll add p50/p95/p99 and an example per-1k-token cost. I'll tag them as internal bench.
claire (Content): I can edit to a 55-65 word opener and move the how-to steps into numbered bullets. Also propose a short FAQ at the bottom.
sam (Sales): Sales needs: standard lead tag, HubSpot field mapping, and a single-slide "qualification" card. Also ask that webhook captures company_domain and job_title.
dee (Growth): Suggested utm: utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_content=compact_playbook. Lead property: launch_source=optimize_blog
ishaan (Product): Bench numbers added to doc: p50=21ms, p95=88ms, p99=142ms; cost approx $0.0018 per 1k tokens on recommended preset (internal bench).
pat (Marketing): i'll attribute numbers as "internal benchmark (typical workload)". Thanks.
notify-bot: provisional webinar created 2026-05-18T16:00Z -> https://cal.example/w/compact123
sam (Sales): webinar week-after publish works. Sales will host two partner seats. Please include a quick export of playbook downloads (CSV) for outbound.
claire (Content): proposed post flow: 1) 1-line problem, 2) 4-step playbook, 3) benchmark box, 4) quickstart code snippet, 5) gated asset CTA -> webinar. I'll draft two subject lines for A/B.
dee (Growth): webhook payload sample for devs (confirm fields): POST /webhooks/hubspot { "email":"{{email}}","first_name":"{{first_name}}","company":"{{company}}","company_domain":"{{company_domain}}","job_title":"{{job_title}}","utm_campaign":"optimize_launch","lead_tag":"optimize_blog","model_profile":"{{model_profile}}","asset_type":"one_pager","is_partner":"{{is_partner}}" }
pat (Marketing): adding partner UTM param when relevant. Timeline: lock copy Thu, assets Fri, publish Tue. Copy-lock review in #marketing Thu 15:00. I'll post when copy-locked.
